evidence.quote: Included in these negotiations were semaglutide based products Ozempic®, Rybelsus® and Wegovy® from Novo Nordisk.
evidence.label: Novo Nordisk 20-F FY2025, p. 7

impact.math: Ex-U.S. price effect H1 2026 -31% [LLY:10q_2026Q2.md p.28] on H1 2025 ex-U.S. revenue $8,983M [p.28] = about -$2,785M; Q2 alone -36% x $4,743M = about -$1,707M. IRA-selected revenue share: Lilly Trulicity $4,276M (2,914 + 1,362) + Verzenio $5,723M = $9,999M / $65,179M = 15.3% [LLY:10k_FY2025.md p.65, p.49]; Novo 79.9% of revenue (force_summary table, NVO row).
impact.estimate: Roughly $2.8B of H1 2026 revenue given up to ex-U.S. price; Lilly's IRA exposure is about one-fifth of Novo's by revenue share, but its ex-U.S. self-pay mix makes it more exposed to cash-pay price competition such as generic semaglutide abroad.

peer: Novo: semaglutide (Ozempic, Rybelsus, Wegovy) negotiated Medicare price effective 2027 [NVO:20f_FY2025.md p.7]; IRA-exposed share 79.9% vs Lilly 15.3% (force_summary table). Lilly's IRA exposure begins 2028 with Trulicity and Verzenio [LLY:10k_FY2025.md p.28].
not_obvious_because: China NRDL pricing was mentioned on calls, but the Q2 2026 crossover of Mounjaro ex-U.S. over U.S. revenue is arithmetic from the 10-Q table that no call I checked stated; the market frames Lilly as a U.S. pricing story.
confidence_reason: All operands verified; the self-pay 75% figure is from Q3 2025 and may have shifted with China NRDL reimbursement.

Sensitivity: Zepbound U.S. revenue H1 2026 $9,006M [LLY:10q_2026Q2.md p.29]; every 10% of U.S. Zepbound volume that migrates from single-dose pens to KwikPen at a 36% lower price = about 9,006 x 2 x 10% x 36% = about $648M a year, before any rebate offset.
impact.estimate: Up to about $0.65B annual revenue per 10% of volume migrating, if net pricing follows the acquisition-cost gap; true effect depends on rebates Lilly no longer has to pay on the lower-list SKU.

why_this_product: Zepbound plus Mounjaro were 65% of Lilly revenue in H1 2026 [LLY:10q_2026Q2.md p.26], and Zepbound is the product whose U.S. Medicare access depends on the time-limited Bridge program, so label breadth matters for revenue after 2027.
fine_print_edge: Zepbound's U.S. label covers adult weight management and moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea only [drug:zepbound:label_sections.md p.2], while Wegovy injection adds cardiovascular risk reduction, adolescents 12 and older, and MASH, and Wegovy tablets also carry the CV indication [drug:wegovy:label_sections.md p.2]; Lilly's own oral, Foundayo, is weight-only but can be taken 'with or without food' with a 9 mg cap alongside strong CYP3A4 inhibitors [drug:foundayo:label_sections.md p.4, p.6].
